items.summary: Chip participation broadened beyond the largest AI names. Reuters' closing report replaces the earlier intraday breadth narrative; repeat participation and earnings delivery are the next tests.

items.title: CoreWeave rally carries into the close as demand meets financing risk
items.summary: CoreWeave's earnings prompted gains across AI infrastructure. Contracted demand supports the recovery, while heavy interest costs and service-delivery conditions temper the backlog signal. Watch cash generation, financing and backlog conversion.

items.title: Capricor stands out ahead of FDA target date; approval remains uncertain
items.summary: Capricor's reported intraday surge coincided with its regulatory update. The company reiterates the FDA target date for deramiocel, with an amended application and inspection response still under review. Approval, label scope and manufacturing feedback remain binary risks; the stock move is not a verified close.

observations.label: Share observation, November 11 at 1:04 PM EST
observations.value: +19.70% reported by Stock Titan; intraday, single-source price observation, not a closing quote

observations.label: FDA target action date
observations.value: November 22, 2026; target date is not approval

observations.label: Regulatory qualification
observations.value: Company says major BLA amendment extended review three months; July inspection produced one Form 483 observation; response submitted, FDA feedback awaited

items.key_finding: The catalyst is documented, while approval odds cannot be inferred from the intraday rally.

items.title: Oil rebounds at settlement while Hormuz flow risk stays unresolved
items.summary: Oil recovered as diplomatic uncertainty supported supply concerns. The new settlement report updates the earlier shipping-risk watch without establishing additional lost oil volume. Watch transit evidence, insurance costs and official inventories; security warnings alone do not measure throughput.
